! sql postgres: create role azpgaad_test_plain2 nologin

$ azpgaad role create --name azpgaad_test_plain2 --oid aaaaaaaa-0000-0000-0000-000000000001 --type user
exit 1
--- stderr
azpgaad: error: role "azpgaad_test_plain2" already exists (use --if-not-exists to skip it, or --on-conflict)

$ azpgaad role create --name azpgaad_test_plain2 --oid aaaaaaaa-0000-0000-0000-000000000001 --type user --on-conflict skip
exit 1
--- stderr
azpgaad: error: role "azpgaad_test_plain2" already exists but is not a Microsoft Entra role (--on-conflict relabel maps it to the object ID)

$ azpgaad role create --name azpgaad_test_plain2 --oid aaaaaaaa-0000-0000-0000-000000000001 --type user --on-conflict relabel --dry-run
exit 0
--- stdout
{
  "dryRun": true,
  "principals": [
    {
      "name": "azpgaad_test_plain2",
      "oid": "aaaaaaaa-0000-0000-0000-000000000001",
      "action": "relabelled"
    }
  ]
}

$ azpgaad role create --name azpgaad_test_plain2 --oid aaaaaaaa-0000-0000-0000-000000000001 --type user --on-conflict recreate --echo
exit 0
--- stdout
{
  "dryRun": false,
  "principals": [
    {
      "name": "azpgaad_test_plain2",
      "oid": "aaaaaaaa-0000-0000-0000-000000000001",
      "action": "recreated"
    }
  ]
}
--- stderr
-- [postgres]
BEGIN;
DROP ROLE "azpgaad_test_plain2";
select pg_catalog.pgaadauth_create_principal_with_oid('azpgaad_test_plain2'::text, 'aaaaaaaa-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::text, 'user'::text, false::boolean, false::boolean);
COMMIT;
